technical.summary: Short-term bullish structure (three white soldiers, RSI rising, supertrend bullish) conflicts with intermediate bearish setup (price below 50/200 MAs, below cloud); overbought conditions and weak volume confirmation limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: CHD shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 36 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (217+ days old) with mixed signals and no recent conviction; news data unavailable to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (374.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event 36 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + RSI rising + supertrend bullish + ADX trending create short-term momentum structure with price near support (82.28), offering defined risk entry for tactical swing.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below 50/200 MAs, below Ichimoku cloud, overbought stochastics/Williams %R, zero fundamental support, VIX crisis, earnings binary in 36 days, and macro headwinds (recession yield curve, strong dollar) make risk/reward unfavorable despite short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term technicals (three white soldiers, RSI rising, supertrend bullish) offer tactical structure at support, but macro headwinds (VIX crisis, recession yield curve, strong dollar) and zero fundamental conviction make risk/reward unfavorable for new entry.
